name: smartcloud-optimizer
description: SmartCloud Optimizer — Utho Cloud Rightsizing, FinOps & Anomaly Detection Platform

scripts.start:infra: cd utho-infra-server && (../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 || python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 || python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001)
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "INFRA,OPTIMIZER,WEB" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "npm run start:infra" "npm run start:optimizer" "npm run start:frontend"
